title: Daily check-in
allExpected: Everything is within the expected range today
alreadyCheckedIn: You already checked in today. Saving again replaces the previous record.
atLeastOne: Enter at least one indicator to save.
crewOwn: Each crew member completes their own check-in
crewOwnExplanation: You are viewing {{name}}'s data. Return to your own data to complete your check-in.
trackedOnly: Only the indicators you track are shown. You can skip any step.
partialPressure: Enter both blood pressure values or skip this step.
partialExercise: Enter both times (use 0 if you skipped one), or skip the step.
sourceQuestion: Where did the value come from?

amsler.instructions: Cover one eye at a time and view the Amsler grid at your usual reading distance. Record only what you noticed.
amsler.noneMarked: If you mark nothing and continue, the record will be "no change" in both eyes.
amsler.distorted: Did any lines look bent or wavy?
amsler.missing: Was any area or part of the grid missing?
amsler.disclaimer: Demonstration self-test: it does not diagnose SANS or replace medical evaluation. You may skip this step.

exerciseSession.resistanceTooLong: The resistance part cannot be longer than the session.
exerciseSession.disclaimer: Record one session from today. The prototype stores type, duration, average aerobic heart rate, and resistance status; it does not assess performance.

conditioning.instructions: Enter the periodic assessment as a percentage of the preflight value and select the apparatus used for each part.
conditioning.disclaimer: The monitoring threshold is {{min}}% of the preflight value. The medical team sets the assessment frequency; this record is not an automated test.

reaction.tooFew: Too few valid responses ({{valid}}). Retake the test or skip the step.
reaction.short: Short version (30 s, for the demo)
reaction.disclaimer: Demo test, without validation equivalent to NASA's Reaction Self Test. Only completed full 3-minute tests enter the personal comparison; the short mode and interrupted tests are kept for reference.
reaction.unknownMode: Mode not recorded; left out of the personal comparison.

sourceNote: Source declared by you. The app does not connect to the device; copy the value and state the source.
